entries.text: Newcomers landed: 8 Mumolu came ashore from elsewhere.
The Mumolu are the island's first hunters.
A new species, the Malebe, branched off the Maleha.
The Maleha are dwindling: from 59 to 24 in 30 days.
Among the Mumolu was born the island's first creature that glows in the dark.
Among the Mumolu, a group grew apart: the Mumohe.
The Mumosi split from the Mumolu.
Hard times for the Maleno: only 15 are left of 32.
The Devuga multiply: 36 now, 9 a month ago.
Hard times for the Malesha: only 27 are left of 92.
